observed: The test failed to locate the native worker by immediate parent/name. It then cleaned the MCP subtree while the Cmd+V request was still pending, and fixture clipboard restoration reported false.
impact: The clipboard snapshot existed only in the exited fixture memory. The pre-run clipboard could not be restored from that run. No clipboard contents were written to evidence.
fix: The controlled-stop fixture resolves the worker within the verified owned subtree using its exact invocation, always awaits the pending input request in finally, and observes clipboard restoration before process cleanup.
subsequentResult: The first rerun still failed worker lookup, but the new finally restored the pre-run clipboard. Exact-command lookup then passed real SIGTERM paste/drag, clipboard restoration, no-held state and final original-snapshot restoration.
